surfaces.name: telemetry
surfaces.what: telemetry.unbrowse.ai: POST /v1/events from nodes, POST /v1/reports (bug reports to GitHub issues), GET /v1/stats/<name> for the team, and the TelemetryStore Durable Object behind them

waive.user: Its only users are nodes, and a node sends only once it is on the network, so a throwaway node can't be a reliable gate. The production watch an hour on stands in: it needs real release nodes' installs in the counts.
